params.prompt:
The town square at the heart of little Bethlehem in the first century, in the quiet just before dawn: a wide open dusty square ringed by flat-roofed limestone and mudbrick houses, a vine-covered pergola over a wooden door, stone steps climbing to rooftops, clay water jars, low stone walls, date palms and cypress trees behind the roofs. Oil lanterns still glow warm amber beside the doorways, while the sky above is deep blue turning to the first gold of sunrise at the horizon. No people; peaceful, the town still asleep. The camera is at the centre of the square, about head height, about to rise up and fly out over the rooftops toward the fields. Composition and layout follow the town-square reference image (a wide panoramic street of houses facing an open square), but drawn in the style below.
STYLE (most important): a 2D hand-drawn illustration in exactly the style of the style reference image (the prophet anointing the kneeling young man): a frame from a hand-drawn epic animated feature film. Confident dark-brown ink outlines around every shape — buildings, stones, trees, pots, figures; simplified, stylised forms; cel-style shading with flat colour areas and soft painted gradients; visible gouache brush texture and a faint warm paper grain; stylised swirling clouds and graphic light rays; warm honey-gold and amber against deep lapis blue. It must clearly read as a drawing and a painting, NOT as a photograph or a 3D render: no photographic detail, no realistic textures, no depth-of-field blur, no lens effects.
Framing: this picture will be shown on an ultra-wide 4:1 LED wall, cropped to a 4:1 strip through the middle of the image. Keep the whole subject and every important detail inside the central horizontal band (the middle 55% of the height). The top and bottom fifth of the image must hold only simple, uneventful sky, darkness, tabletop or ground that can be cut away. Spread the scene wide rather than tall.
